notes: Binary reverse-engineering + matrix recovery: reverse a 16-byte header + fixed-size frame format (XOR-obfuscated int16 payloads, optional delta decoding over valid frames only), then package query+decode logic into an executable script whose CLI writes the recovered (frames x channels) float64 matrix to .npy. Hard floor from the multi-stage decode (status filtering, delta cumsum, payload de-obfuscation), query spec expansion (reversed ranges, duplicates, order-sensitive orientation), and the executable/.npy packaging contract. Hidden cases cover delta vs plain captures, interleaved invalid frames, out-of-order/duplicate query indices, out-of-range indices, and an all-invalid capture yielding a (0, C) matrix; the verifier executes /app/extract.py unchanged and compares shape, dtype, orientation and exact values.
